title: Independent QQ16 all-depth source and primitive certificate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR3303's two arithmetic engines share source loading and event expansion. This adds an independently parsed and expanded source/primitive certificate for its all-depth QQ16 numerical contract, using nonnegative rational polynomials and max-plus affine grids. It imports no predecessor executable and checks all 53,118 events, 270,288 primitive observations, 3,498 monomials and 512 owner inverses, carrying the complete F0 state into B1.

The sufficient bounds agree: quantum h*2^(-71-19*(lambda-1)), signed width P+215+38*(lambda-1), and numeric reference work (372322+110760*lambda)*N+12, with 2112*N conceptual cover transfers and 1426*N+12 numeric words. This is conditional on the stated bounded input lattice and inherited tensor-native/bridge/cover/endpoint semantics; it is not a physical or recursive tariff, supplier or kappa result.

The audit also identifies a displayed second-output transcription difference in PR3303's proof: (d+i*s)/2 instead of the pinned native C's (s-i*d)/2. The former is i times the latter, so the component grid/magnitude bounds and invoice are unchanged. The new proof and sign-sensitive oracle use the source formula. The predecessor is untouched.

## Task and overlap

Task joint-query-controller, priority 6; recursive interfaces, seed 51, scope refined to deliberate independent verification. Base: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90. Audited PR3303: f9031ff1412c9a4e62a38306009ae9c334cfc34e. Exact scientific/provenance pins and the original card are in SOURCES.json and TASK.json.

The live canonical thread and targeted current/historical PR search found no separate raw-source polynomial/max-plus implementation. PR3303's independent.py imports binding.load/expand; PR3394 prices a different routing obligation. This does not repeat PR3181/3189's scalar/noise-lattice or PR3293's one-helper endpoint results. Broader hidden Discussion coverage remains incomplete; no novelty guarantee is claimed. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-19017600).

Only research/qq16-polynomial-interface-audit is added: ten files, with the selected frontier, shared verifiers, frozen inputs and upstream unchanged.

## Validation

    python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-polynomial-interface-audit

Expected: PASS_QQ16_POLYNOMIAL_INTERFACE_AUDIT, eleven passing tests and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Local standard-library CPython 3.12.14: registered replay passed in 14.91 seconds, peak child RSS 189,317,120 bytes. Both direct scripts also passed with -I -O -Werror -B in a regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export, preserving all bytes. Exact Gaussian/component/tensor, native-interior overflow, negative dyadic, state-carry, sweep omission, source/usage/claim/receipt and overwrite controls pass. Final metadata/pins, warning-strict compilation and git diff --check pass. Two separate AI static reviews informed the final corrections; no human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

Ruff was unavailable. Full payload execution, selected cold replay, original native/bridge functional proofs, Lean, Docker and hosted CI were not run for this package. Physical routing/address/control, caller format admission, borrowed-state representation/restoration, recursive tariffs and F17 consumption remain open.

## Open next questions

Pin one actual caller cut supplying the declared lattice, dirty range and frames, then pay its complete ownership, routing, restoration, recursive and F17-consumer invoice. That implementation and allowance are absent; this numerical check alone does not justify another guard optimization. README.md and TASK.json preserve the precise handoff and stop rule.
